# Independent audit of the seven-fiber scalar allocation obstruction

Source: `candidate b04c74715df6cea2`.

**Result: PASS, including the final actual-good-point calibration.** Independently read the full source and checker; reran `supporting computation verify_seven_fiber_density_allocation_obstruction_two_sided.py`: **2,570 exact checks PASS**. The checker expands the printed Bernstein arrays as exact rational polynomial identities, not floating-point samples.

## 1. Exact envelope and scope

The definition of beta is a universal infimum over volume-one convex bodies and all measures with the stated total ceiling and mass, at the prescribed centroid of own volume plus twice that measure. No attainment of this infimum is needed. Its test centroids are inside their bodies because the own-body Lebesgue component has positive density throughout the interior.

For an actual anchor, distinct reflected pairs have disjoint endpoint fibers. Their allocated midpoint measures have the stated masses and ceilings; convex compatibility gives B_j<=k. Volume normalization therefore gives exactly alpha=T/k and L=sum t_j/B_j. The universal beta lower bound is valid for each actual sum measure, but an upper bound on beta is only an upper bound on a guarantee from these scalar hypotheses. It is not an upper bound on the depth of the actual coupling source. The source makes this distinction explicitly and consistently.

The uniform simplex test proves beta<=Gamma_d(1+alpha) throughout the whole domain. The no-pair option includes the own-fiber Grünbaum guarantee. Unpaired mass, individual component geometry, directional marginal shapes, and common midpoint support are not claimed to be encoded by this envelope.

## 2. Two-band witness and exact signs

For the area-one triangle, the upper-rank variable v=(1-x)^2 is uniform. The two proposed rank bands have lengths r/l and (alpha-r)/l, so their total eta mass is alpha and their density is l<=L. Nonoverlap and containment are precisely r<=ls and alpha-r<=l(1-s). All required quantities are affine on the three cells and their endpoint signs pass.

The cap x>=1/3 has own mass s=4/9 and eta mass r=4/25. Its containing-centroid condition is exactly integral sqrt(v) d eta <= 2alpha/3: the projected mean of the own triangle is 1/3, and the eta contribution to height is alpha minus this integral. Direct integration produces J sqrt(l)>=8/125+R^(3/2), with the stated J and R.

The squaring step is sound because J,l,R,C are positive. P>0 yields 125C>16R^(3/2), then lJ^2>(R^(3/2)+8/125)^2. The printed positive Bernstein numerators and denominators reproduce C and P exactly on all three closed cells, including their seams. Thus the witness works for every real alpha in the interval; no numerical extrapolation is used. The low-alpha uniform test meets the band certificate at 9/25.

## 3. Actual body and complete allocation menus

The fiber formula for the truncated two-apex convex hull is exact: any use of both apices has total apex weight at least |z|/4, and the copies of T contracted toward its own vertex are nested. Hence the complete integer base is exactly -3,...,3 and the seven positive areas sum to 11/4.

At the central base, the three reflected pairs have B values 9/16, 1/4, 1/16. The exact finite linear exchange argument fills the largest B first and gives the three stated pieces of L_min. It covers the continuum of every allowed allocation; it does not alter the original pair geometry. Thus every central allocation has scalar certificate at most 136/225.

At a positive noncentral base p, the pairs are exactly {p-h,p+h}, 1<=h<=3-p. Their smaller areas are V_(p+h). Consequently k+T is at most sum_(j=p)^3 V_j, which is at most 7/8. The uniform test therefore gives at most 7/18 for every such menu; reflection covers negative bases. This includes the endpoint no-pair cases. The exact target gap is 11/18-136/225=1/150.

## 4. Integer-rank padding and actual safety

Binary padding introduces no extra reflected pairs: coordinatewise, e+f=2g for binary vectors forces e=f=g. The menu at every anchor is unchanged, while the original mixed mass grows by 2^(n-1), exactly canceled by the OC factor. All bodies have ambient interior and every sampled fiber has full continuous dimension. No affine lattice normalization or intrinsic-measure substitution is used.

The final good point is a genuine point of the central fiber, namely P/4. The identical neighboring fibers F=(3/4)T+P/4 have that centroid, area 9/16, and are contained in T. For every nonvertical ambient cap through this point, the contained own copy pays Gamma_2|F|, and the audited ordinary paired-centroid-tail theorem pays 2Gamma_2|F| for the two opposite integer shifts. This gives raw depth at least 3/4. A pure integer cap contains the own fiber and at least one neighbor, and the other binary blocks only add mass. A containing boundary can be translated through the point. Thus the explicit depth bound exceeds the original target 11/18 by 5/36.

This last calculation confirms the exact scope: the actual body satisfies OC by retained pair geometry, while every certificate in the deliberately scalar envelope falls short.
